source_name: MPEDA (Marine Products Export Development Authority) official Press Release Note, "India's seafood exports USD 7.45 billion in FY 2024-25", dated 09.07.2025
notes: Verified directly from MPEDA's own official press release PDF (link above), superseding the earlier aggregator-republication citation. Aggregate figures: total seafood exports FY2024-25 = 1,698,170 MT / INR 62,408.45 crore / USD 7.45 billion. Frozen shrimp alone = 741,529 MT / INR 43,334.25 crore / USD 5,177.01 million (43.67% of quantity, 69.46% of dollar earnings from seafood). Per-country breakdown above is QUANTITY (MT) ONLY for frozen shrimp specifically — the press release does not break out shrimp-only USD by destination. It does give total-seafood USD by destination (US: $2,714.94M / 346,868 MT, of which shrimp is 92.55% of value; China: $1,276.58M / 396,424 MT; EU: $1,125.60M / 215,080 MT; Southeast Asia: $974.99M / 347,541 MT; Japan: $411.55M / 102,933 MT; Middle East: $278.31M / 65,956 MT) — that is all-seafood, not shrimp-only, so it is not used to fill the shrimp value_usd column (would require an estimate, which the site's rule against inventing numbers disallows). A more recent FY2025-26 figure was also seen elsewhere (total frozen shrimp 792,647 MT, USA 256,128 MT, China 169,505 MT, value USD 5,624.48 million) but wasn't used as the primary year here since its country breakdown wasn't independently verified against a primary document in this pass; worth revisiting for a 2025-26 update.
